description_en: Creates a run for the specified optimization task and returns the run ID. When preview is set to true, an independent pre-run is executed to generate candidate results and evidence. The pre-run does not publish candidate artifacts or advance the formal run history
description_zh: 为指定优化任务创建运行并返回运行标识。preview=true 时执行独立预运行，生成候选结果和证据；预运行不发布候选产物，也不推进正式运行历史
name: CreateOptimizeRun

parameters.help_en: The name of the optimization task
parameters.name: optimize_task_name

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Use the same value when you retry the same creation request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token；重试同一次创建请求时使用相同值
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The JSON input defined by the task type, preserving the original object or array structure. ExperienceMining accepts a start/end/processTimeMaxNS object. SkillOptimize accepts an inline input array, a skills/window object for SLS, or a skills/records object for ATIF or xTrace. The server validates the input based on the task type and configuration. Memory extraction continues to use the original ContextStore API
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型定义的 JSON 输入，保持对象或数组原始结构。ExperienceMining 接受 start/end/processTimeMaxNS 对象；SkillOptimize 接受内联输入数组、SLS 的 skills/window 对象，或 ATIF/xTrace 的 skills/records 对象。服务端按任务类型和配置校验输入；记忆抽取继续使用原有 ContextStore 接口
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to execute an independent pre-run of the complete algorithm. The pre-run generates candidate results and evidence without publishing them to the target dataset or advancing the formal run history. A formal run executes the algorithm independently
parameters.help_zh: 完整算法的独立预运行；生成候选结果和证据，不发布到目标 Dataset，也不推进正式运行历史。正式运行独立执行算法
parameters.name: preview
